message:
In the concealed under-deck support frame (C2), the bolted cross-frame connection forces for the 400 kilogram added mass have no quantified static plus dynamic sizing and fatigue check, Retrofit Integration Architect. To check it I used whiteboard review of the concealed mounting cross-section (E7) against the optimal Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) sizing (E4). I found 0 Newtons documented for connection load, according to Human Induced Vibrations of Steel Structures (HIVOSS), 2008. I propose Retrofit Integration Architect computes interface forces and fatigue demand before comfort sign-off. My position: not ready because support safety is unproven.

In the under-deck TMD retrofit (C1), the off-tune comfort and stroke margin for 5 percent frequency drift has no calculation, Vibration Control Specialist. To check it I used review of the controlled-response stroke estimate (E6) building on the resonant response calculation (E1). I found 8.2 millimetres stroke and 0.20 metres per second squared only on-tune, according to Den Hartog, 1934. I propose Vibration Control Specialist simulates detuned response and stroke before any proposal. My position: not ready because robustness to real drift is unknown.

In the bare 40 metre footbridge baseline, the comfort target needs frozen limits before sizing closes, Structural Dynamics Lead and Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner. To check it I used standards review of the resonant response calculation (E1). I found 1.75 metres per second squared baseline above limit, according to HIVOSS, 2008. I propose Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner holds any proposal until the blocking process objection is resolved. My position: not ready because a vote now would come too early.

Note on Structural Dynamics Lead: baseline resonance quantified but needs team review.
Note on Vibration Control Specialist: on-tune sizing done, off-tune check requested.
Note on Retrofit Integration Architect: concealment layout done, connection forces requested.
Note on Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner: comfort target stated, sign-off deferred pending checks.
